title: Household goods weight allowance by pay grade
caption: Table 5-37. PCS and NTS Weight Allowances (Pounds)

source.title: Joint Travel Regulations
source.quote: Table 5-37. PCS and NTS Weight Allowances (Pounds) Pay Grade With Dependents Without Dependents

sources.title: Joint Travel Regulations
sources.quote: The weight allowance for a Service member authorized in this table is the total combined weight of any HHG shipped, plus any unaccompanied baggage shipped, and any HHG in storage.

sources.title: Joint Travel Regulations
sources.quote: For Table 5-37, a Service member with dependents is one who has a dependent eligible to travel at Government expense due to a PCS, regardless if the dependent actually travels.

sources.title: Joint Travel Regulations
sources.quote: The weight of PBP&E, required medical equipment, and gun safes are not included in the HHG weight allowance authorized.

sources.title: Personal Property Entitlements
sources.quote: Service members are authorized up to 2,000 lbs. of pro-gear. Spouses are authorized up to 500 lbs. of pro-gear related to their profession.

sources.title: Personal Property Entitlements
sources.quote: It is crucial to stay within your weight allowance, as you will be required to pay for any overages.
